title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Multi-Discipline Practices (MDP)
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal wishes to form a partnership with a licensed accountant to provide a "one-stop" service for small businesses (incorporation, accounting, and Small Claims litigation). Under LSO By-laws, what is a primary condition for this Multi-Discipline Practice (MDP)?
options: The paralegal must retain at least 50% ownership and voting control over the partnership.
The paralegal cannot form a partnership with a non-licensee under any circumstances.
The paralegal must register the accountant as an LSO licensee.
The accountant must agree to be bound by the paralegal's Rules of Conduct in all their accounting work.
questions.explain: Currently, under LSO By-law 7, while lawyers may form Multi-Discipline Practices (MDPs) with non-licensees under strict conditions, paralegals are *not* permitted to form partnerships or MDPs with non-licensees (such as accountants or immigration consultants). They can only partner with other LSO licensees (lawyers or paralegals).
